title: Data Leakage
summary: Information that will not exist at prediction time enters training and inflates measured performance.
recognition_signals: a preprocessing step uses the whole dataset before splitting
evaluation or future data influences training
measured performance is much better than later real use
core_rules: Any transformation that learns from data must be fit on training data only.
structural_steps: fit every learned transformation on the training split
apply the fitted transformation to the other splits

common_confusions.distinction: Leakage lets information the model should not have inflate the evaluation. Overfitting is a model that memorizes training signal and generalizes poorly on honest data.

source_refs.title: scikit-learn: Common pitfalls and recommended practices
